newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-CHALMERS TAKEN TO HOSPITAL WITH CONCUSSION.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CHALMERS TAKEN TO HOSPITAL WITH CONCUSSION.

text.p: Scotland fly-half Craig Chalmers, knocked unconscious by a tackle in Saturday's Five Nations' championship 47-20 defeat to France, was taken to hospital with concussion.
Chalmers, who left the pitch on a stretcher in the 51st minute of the match at Parc des Princes, recovered consciousness after 10 minutes but was kept in hospital for further checks.
Chalmers was tackled by French centre Christophe Lamaison, who said he had not committed an offence.
"We must look at the video but it looked fair," said Scotland coach Richie Dixon.
